episodes.title: Reading Velocity-Time Graphs
episodes.question: How do we read motion from a velocity-time graph?
episodes.answer: The slope is acceleration, area is displacement.
episodes.solution: Explain that slope = change in v / change in t.
episodes.visual_hook: A car moving with changing velocity.

episodes.visual_hook: Two arrows and the shadow of one on the other.
